def max_chain_length(r, c, grid):
    """Find the maximum chain of working cells through (r,c) - any continuous line"""
    if grid[r][c] != 1:

    # Try going in all 4 directions from (r,c)

        # Go in this direction until we hit a 4 or edge

        nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
        while (0 <= nr < len(grid) and 0 <= nc < len(grid[0]) and grid[nr][nc] == 1):
            length += 1
            nr += dr
            nc += dc
        
        # Go backward (dr == 0, dc == 0: don't double count)
        if dr == 0 and dc == 0:

        length += 1  # count (r,c) again
